changelog: Movies & shows: re-examine items tagged NR/Not Rated/12/0+ (not just blank ones), only ever write a certification Jellyfin recognizes (never a foreign format), and label anything still unresolved with a configurable "Unidentifiable movie/show rating" (default "Unrated").
description: Fills in missing parental ratings for music (Deezer), movies & shows (TMDb), and anime (MyAnimeList) so parental controls work across the whole library.
name: Chaperone
overview: Automatic parental ratings across music, movies, shows, and anime.
